verdict.rationale: Orrick publishes web-based resources, so offering an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for this product. However, a probe of https://www.orrick.com/llms.txt returned HTTP 404. No evidence shows any agent-oriented documentation; the Tech Studio forms are interactive pages that require cookies to load.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
